title: Things That Took More Water
description: I built an illustrated educational website about AI water use, using everyday comparisons and research notes to make the topic accessible.

title: NOOG alpha and Cosmic Conference
description: I created NOOG, an experimental Chrome extension for filtering unwanted content, and the Cosmic Conference website for an October 31 event with talks, live music, and DJs on Salt Spring Island.

title: Introducing Overshoot
description: I built Overshoot to trace where the materials in our world come from and where they go. The project grew from an agent tool into a public planetary atlas.
